name: How We Met
source: Karlie was stuck in the foster system until she turned 18 and left her foster parents for the big city. Penniless she stays with a friend and learns the streets until she finds Dustin, a former foster kid who made it.​
translation: 卡莉一直辗转于寄养体系，直到18岁时离开养父母，前往大城市。身无分文的她暂住在朋友家，摸索街头的生存之道，直到遇见达斯汀，一个同样出身寄养家庭、却已闯出一片天地的人。
